newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Dec 2.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $28 billion of three- and six-month bills on Dec 2 to raise $1.15 billion as $26.838 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Dec 5. The three-month bills mature March 6 and the six-month bills mature June 5.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942M5 and for the six-month bills is 9127944L5.
